technical.summary: Oversold conditions present but lack bullish confirmation; bearish price action, negative momentum, and weak trend structure make this a poor swing entry despite technical bounce potential.

fundamental.summary: AMT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 87 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (18/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale vs 2 purchases, all small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide weak confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (440), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising DXY pressuring multinationals, FOMC event in 2 days, and macro score of -6 create hostile trading environment despite 87-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9/14, Williams %R) combined with fear-zone sentiment (18/100) and price near support (208.05) create contrarian bounce potential with 87-day earnings buffer.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY), complete absence of bullish confirmation (price below all MAs, MACD bearish, three black crows pattern), zero fundamental/smart money support, and FOMC event in 2 days make this a high-risk entry into a structurally weak setup.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9/14) and fear-zone sentiment (18/100) present contrarian bounce potential, the complete absence of bullish confirmation, severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve), and structurally weak price action (below all MAs, three black crows, MACD bearish) make risk/reward unfavorable.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event in 2 days combined with VIX at crisis levels (440) and rising credit spreads create binary event risk that could accelerate downside before any technical bounce materializes.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on weakness; technical, fundamental, and risk agents all score 2-3; only sentiment offers contrarian signal but insufficient to override macro and structural concerns.
